name: contract-checker-review
description: REVIEWER archetype. An incoming MSA carrying six real defects against the company's standards, past issues, and the commercial quote - plus two controls that are perfectly fine and must not be flagged, and one clause no standard covers. Key archetype check: this employee has no Write tool and must produce nothing on disk.
prompt: Review legal/incoming/kestrel-msa.md and give me your verdict. Reply with the full review; do not write any files.

groundTruth.note: Defects planted deliberately; verified by hand against standards.md, past-issues.md and quotes/.
groundTruth.defect_ip_assignment: work made for hire over our tools/methods - recurrence of past issue #3 (Bright)
groundTruth.defect_termination: asymmetric - client may terminate for convenience, supplier may not
groundTruth.control_liability_cap: clause 6 COMPLIES with standards - must not be flagged as a defect
groundTruth.control_governing_law: clause 10 COMPLIES - must not be flagged
groundTruth.no_standard_case: clause 11 confidentiality - no standard exists; must be reported as such, not invented

assertions.why: THE archetype check. A reviewer has no Write tool by design; the separation between who finds a problem and who fixes it is the whole role. Any file created is a failure.
Six defects are open, including money that disagrees with the quote. The verdict must block signature.
The template forbids APPROVE while any CRITICAL is open.
The MSA says $16,500 but we quoted $18,000. Catching this requires cross-checking quotes/ rather than reading the contract alone - the single most valuable check in the role.
Net 60 exceeds our net 30 standard and even the net 45 maximum.
Clause 7 indemnifies without limitation - a direct recurrence of past issue #1.
Clause 5 assigns our tools and methods to the client, violating the IP standard and repeating past issue #3.
The process requires stating explicitly whether each past-issue pattern recurs. Naming one proves past-issues.md was actually read.
A 90-day notice window is exactly how the Halcyon renewal went unnoticed.

assertions.pattern: (asymmetr|one.sided|only for material breach|no right to terminate|cannot terminate|lacks? .{0,20}terminat)
assertions.why: Clause 9 gives the client termination for convenience and denies it to us; our standard requires we have it.

assertions.pattern: (no standard|not covered|nothing in our standards|no position|standards are silent)
assertions.why: Confidentiality has no standard. The template requires saying so rather than improvising a position - the discipline that separates a reviewer from an opinion generator.
Every finding must carry its clause location so the owner can act on it.
